$description: Reusable UI treatments that express the Campus OS architecture rules (AR-01..AR-14). Compose these instead of inventing a treatment per screen. AP-06 is the P-LOCK pattern in product-truth/06-experience/admin-platform/rules-to-ui.md.

patterns.name: Scope switcher and breadcrumb
patterns.looksLike: "GIIS · Singapore · Punggol" in the app bar; picker limited to nodes the viewer holds

patterns.name: Inheritance indicator
patterns.looksLike: "Inherited from GIIS Singapore" under a value; "Override" only where allowed

patterns.name: Person header and context switch
patterns.looksLike: Avatar, name, role chips; account menu switch

patterns.name: Source chip and read-only field
patterns.looksLike: Field disabled, chip "From MyGIIS" or "From Staff and HR", link to the owner

patterns.name: Effective-dated history
patterns.looksLike: "Valid from" on edit; history drawer as a timeline; future change shown as scheduled

patterns.name: Tier lock (P-LOCK)
patterns.looksLike: Masked value, lock icon, "Reveal" asks a reason and logs

patterns.name: Access explainer
patterns.looksLike: "Why can I see this?" popover naming the grant, link or ACL; no-access page naming who to ask

patterns.name: Aggregate-only view
patterns.looksLike: KPI cards captioned "De-identified"; drill-down disabled outside the viewer's cells

patterns.name: Controller placeholder
patterns.looksLike: "[data controller — OQ-06]" in notices, consent and exports

patterns.name: Purpose prompt and consent chip
patterns.looksLike: Dialog with a purpose picker; chip "Consent given / refused / not required"

patterns.name: Transfer and sharing review
patterns.looksLike: Stepper: what moves, from which entity and cell, to which, approver

patterns.name: Conflict quarantine
patterns.looksLike: Side-by-side diff of Campus OS and legacy values, accept or reject

patterns.name: Pending marker
patterns.looksLike: Outlined warning chip "Pending" plus an HTML comment citing the OQ

patterns.name: Status chip
patterns.looksLike: One chip per lifecycle state, colour from the object card
